headline: Approved bimonthly meetings starting January 2027 on the third Tuesday of each month; approved prior minutes.
summary: Chief Morello said the Traffic Division is back to regular staffing and that the long-term goal is to increase it. Members approved the minutes of the July 21, 2026 meeting and changed meetings to bimonthly starting January 2027.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 21, 2026 meeting, 2 yes and 1 abstention.
Changed meetings to bimonthly starting January 2027, on the third Tuesday of the month, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Lemieux moved to APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE JULY 21, 2026 POLICE COMMISSION TRAFFIC SUB-COMMITTEE, Seconded by Commissioner Ghio. 2 – Yes 1 – abstention Vote: Passed

Commissioner Lemieux moved to CHANGE THE TRAFFIC SUB-COMMITTEE MEETING TO BI-MONTHLY STARTING JANUARY 2027, ON THE THIRD TUESDAY OF THE MONTH AND CHANGING THE TIME TO 5:30 P.M., seconded by Commissioner Ghio. Vote: Unanimously Passed

decision_titles: Change to bimonthly meeting schedule starting January 2027
plain_text:
POLICE COMMISSION TRAFFIC SUB-COMMITTEE 
October 20, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.  
Council Chambers, City Hall 
 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 
 
 
 
 
PRESENT:                ABSENT:  
Sue Tyler, Council Member/Police Commissioner 
Rory Ghio, Commissioner – via Zoom 
Paul Lemieux, Police Commissioner 
Mark Morello, Police Chief 
 
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Council Member Tyler called the meeting to order at 5:03 p.m. 
 
2. PUBLIC PARTICIPATION 
None 
 
 
3. APPROVAL OF MINUTES 
Commissioner Lemieux moved to APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE JULY 21, 2026 POLICE 
COMMISSION TRAFFIC SUB-COMMITTEE, Seconded by Commissioner Ghio.            
 
2 – Yes 
1 – abstention        Vote: Passed     
 
4. OLD BUSINESS 
Council Member Tyler asked about the status of the Traffic Division’s staffing. Chief Morello informed the 
Board that the Traffic Division is back to regular staffing. The long-term goal is to increase the staffing in the 
Traffic Division. Council Member Tyler asked the Chief about the Traffic Division's long-term goals. Chief 
Morello responded that we are currently revisiting the Traffic Maintenance Roll.   
 
Commissioner Lemieux asked that the Department post the grant stats on its website. 
 
 
 
5. NEW BUSINESS 
Council Member Tyler suggested that the Traffic Sub-Committee meet monthly starting in January 2027.  A 
discussion was held. 
 
Commissioner Lemieux moved to CHANGE THE TRAFFIC SUB-COMMITTEE MEETING TO BI-
MONTHLY STARTING JANUARY 2027, ON THE THIRD TUESDAY OF THE MONTH AND 
CHANGING THE TIME TO 5:30 P.M., seconded by Commissioner Ghio. 
 
           Vote: Unanimously Passed
6. ADJOURNMENT 
Commissioner Lemieux moved to ADJOURN, Seconded by Commissioner Ghio. 
 
           VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
The Police Commission Traffic Sub-committee meeting for October 20, 2026, was hereby adjourned.  
At 5:43 p.m.  
           
 
           Lisa Ziogas 
Recording Secretary
